profile_topics.notes: Teacher style is heavily bias-led.
Continuation is one of the clearest executable teacher-style ideas.
Expansion is a central directional condition.
Protected swings drive confirmation and invalidation.

Reversal remains part of the style even though it is less mature than continuation in the current corpus.
